text: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra was born in Alcala de Henares, near Madrid. During his life, he wrote many novels and plays. Don Quixote is the most famous novel that he wrote. It was first published in 1605, and is still considered one of the most influential works of classical literature. The novel Don Quixote tells the story of Alonso Quijana, a thin country gentleman who reads many books. He begins to believe he's living in an imaginary world, changes his name to “Don Quixote de La Mancha’, and starts on a journey to find adventure with the help of his friend Sancho Panza. Don Quixote has an interesting vision of the things happening around him. He fights imaginary battles to make the world a better place, but the people he intends to help say that he is crazy. Prepare yourself to see and hear this fantastic story now in English, and improve your speaking and listening skills along the way.
